title: Daftar 10 Produk
description: Tampilkan product_id, product_name, dan price dari 10 produk dengan urutan product_id.
query_hints: SELECT product_id, product_name, price FROM products ORDER BY product_id LIMIT 10;

title: Pelanggan dari Jakarta
description: Tampilkan customer_id, address_line, city untuk alamat di 'Jakarta' (limit 10).
query_hints: SELECT customer_id, address_line, city FROM customer_addresses WHERE city = 'Jakarta' LIMIT 10;

title: Gaji Besar
description: Tampilkan employee_id, base_salary untuk gaji > 10.000.000 (limit 10).
query_hints: SELECT employee_id, base_salary FROM employee_salaries WHERE base_salary > 10000000 LIMIT 10;

title: Pesanan Pending
description: Tampilkan order_id, order_date, status untuk pesanan berstatus 'Pending' (limit 10).
query_hints: SELECT order_id, order_date, status FROM orders WHERE status = 'Pending' LIMIT 10;

title: Departemen IT
description: Tampilkan department_id, department_name yang bernama 'IT'.
query_hints: SELECT department_id, department_name FROM departments WHERE department_name = 'IT';

title: Jabatan Senior
description: Tampilkan job_title_id, title_name dari level 'Senior'.
query_hints: SELECT job_title_id, title_name FROM job_titles WHERE level = 'Senior';

title: Produk Murah
description: Tampilkan product_name, price yang price < 50000 (limit 10).
query_hints: SELECT product_name, price FROM products WHERE price < 50000 LIMIT 10;

title: Ulasan Bintang 5
description: Tampilkan review_id, rating, comment untuk rating = 5 (limit 10).
query_hints: SELECT review_id, rating, comment FROM reviews WHERE rating = 5 LIMIT 10;

title: Info Supplier
description: Tampilkan company_name, email dari semua supplier (limit 10).
query_hints: SELECT company_name, email FROM suppliers LIMIT 10;

title: Biaya Kirim Express
description: Tampilkan method_name, base_cost untuk nama 'Express'.
query_hints: SELECT method_name, base_cost FROM shipping_methods WHERE method_name = 'Express';

title: Total Karyawan per Departemen
description: Tampilkan department_name (tabel departments) dan total_emp (jumlah karyawan dari tabel employees) untuk tiap departemen. Urutkan dari total karyawan terbanyak.
query_hints: SELECT d.department_name, COUNT(e.employee_id) as total_emp FROM departments d JOIN employees e ON d.department_id = e.department_id GROUP BY d.department_name ORDER BY total_emp DESC;

title: Stok per Kategori
description: Tampilkan category_name dan total_stock (total dari stock_quantity) per kategori produk.
query_hints: SELECT c.category_name, SUM(p.stock_quantity) as total_stock FROM product_categories c JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.category_name;

title: Rata-rata Gaji per Jabatan
description: Tampilkan title_name dan avg_salary (rata-rata base_salary di-round 2 desimal).
query_hints: SELECT j.title_name, ROUND(AVG(s.base_salary), 2) as avg_salary FROM job_titles j JOIN employees e ON j.job_title_id = e.job_title_id JOIN employee_salaries s ON e.employee_id = s.employee_id GROUP BY j.title_name;

title: Total Pendapatan per Status
description: Tampilkan status pesanan dan total_rev (jumlah dari total_amount) dari tabel orders.
query_hints: SELECT status, SUM(total_amount) as total_rev FROM orders GROUP BY status;

title: Pesanan Pelanggan
description: Tampilkan first_name, last_name (dari customers) dan order_id, total_amount (dari orders) (limit 10).
query_hints: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, o.order_id, o.total_amount FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id LIMIT 10;

title: Top 5 Supplier
description: Tampilkan company_name dan product_count (jumlah produk). Urutkan dari produk terbanyak (limit 5).
query_hints: SELECT s.company_name, COUNT(p.product_id) as product_count FROM suppliers s JOIN products p ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id GROUP BY s.company_name ORDER BY product_count DESC LIMIT 5;

title: Rating Rata-rata Produk
description: Tampilkan product_name dan avg_rating (dari reviews, round 1 desimal). Tampilkan 10 teratas urut id.
query_hints: SELECT p.product_name, ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 1) as avg_rating FROM products p JOIN reviews r ON p.product_id = r.product_id GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY p.product_name LIMIT 10;

title: Hitung Invoice Lunas
description: Tampilkan status invoice dan total_invoices (jumlah kemunculan).
query_hints: SELECT status, COUNT(invoice_id) as total_invoices FROM invoices GROUP BY status;

title: Jumlah Item per Pesanan
description: Tampilkan order_id dan total_items (jumlah total quantity). Urutkan dari order_id (limit 10).
query_hints: SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity) as total_items FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id ORDER BY order_id LIMIT 10;

title: Penggunaan Metode Kirim
description: Tampilkan method_name dan usage_count (berapa kali dipakai di tabel orders).
query_hints: SELECT m.method_name, COUNT(o.order_id) as usage_count FROM shipping_methods m JOIN orders o ON m.method_id = o.method_id GROUP BY m.method_name;

title: Pelanggan Tanpa Pesanan
description: Tampilkan customer_id dan first_name dari pelanggan yang belum pernah melakukan pesanan (Gunakan LEFT JOIN).
query_hints: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_id IS NULL;

title: Produk Tak Terjual
description: Tampilkan product_id dan product_name dari produk yang tidak ada di order_items.
query_hints: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE oi.order_id IS NULL;

title: Karyawan Gaji Tertinggi
description: Tampilkan first_name, last_name, base_salary untuk karyawan yang memiliki gaji pokok (base_salary) terbesar. (Gunakan Subquery).
query_hints: SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, s.base_salary FROM employees e JOIN employee_salaries s ON e.employee_id = s.employee_id WHERE s.base_salary = (SELECT MAX(base_salary) FROM employee_salaries);

title: Pesanan Paling Mahal
description: Tampilkan order_id, first_name pelanggan, dan total_amount untuk pesanan dengan total_amount tertinggi.
query_hints: SELECT o.order_id, c.first_name, o.total_amount FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.total_amount = (SELECT MAX(total_amount) FROM orders);

title: Kategori Mahal
description: Tampilkan category_name dan avg_price (rata-rata harga produk di kategori tsb). Hanya tampilkan jika avg_price > 1000000.
query_hints: SELECT c.category_name, ROUND(AVG(p.price), 2) as avg_price FROM product_categories c JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.category_name HAVING AVG(p.price) > 1000000;

title: Total Pembayaran per Metode
description: Tampilkan payment_method dan total_paid dari tabel payments.
query_hints: SELECT payment_method, SUM(amount) as total_paid FROM payments GROUP BY payment_method;

title: Pelanggan Kecewa (Bintang 1)
description: Tampilkan secara unik (DISTINCT) first_name dan last_name dari pelanggan yang pernah memberi review bintang 1.
query_hints: SELECT DISTINCT c.first_name, c.last_name FROM customers c JOIN reviews r ON c.customer_id = r.customer_id WHERE r.rating = 1;

title: Departemen Padat Karyawan
description: Tampilkan department_name dan emp_count untuk departemen yang memiliki lebih dari 5 karyawan.
query_hints: SELECT d.department_name, COUNT(e.employee_id) as emp_count FROM departments d JOIN employees e ON d.department_id = e.department_id GROUP BY d.department_name HAVING COUNT(e.employee_id) > 5;

title: Nilai Pesanan per Kota
description: Tampilkan city (dari address) dan total_city_amount (sum dari total_amount pesanan). Limit 10.
query_hints: SELECT ca.city, SUM(o.total_amount) as total_city_amount FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN customer_addresses ca ON c.customer_id = ca.customer_id GROUP BY ca.city LIMIT 10;

title: Supplier Elektronik
description: Tampilkan DISTINCT company_name yang mensuplai produk dengan category_name = 'Electronics'.
query_hints: SELECT DISTINCT s.company_name FROM suppliers s JOIN products p ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id JOIN product_categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.category_name = 'Electronics';

title: Ranking Harga Produk
description: Tampilkan product_name, category_id, price, dan rank_price (ranking harga tertinggi per kategori). (Gunakan RANK() OVER ...). Limit 10.
query_hints: SELECT product_name, category_id, price, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category_id ORDER BY price DESC) as rank_price FROM products LIMIT 10;

title: Top 3 Gaji Tiap Departemen
description: Gunakan CTE. Dapatkan first_name, department_id, base_salary yang masuk 3 besar gaji tertinggi di tiap departemen. Limit 15.
query_hints: WITH RankedSalaries AS (SELECT e.first_name, e.department_id, s.base_salary, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY e.department_id ORDER BY s.base_salary DESC) as rank FROM employees e JOIN employee_salaries s ON e.employee_id = s.employee_id) SELECT first_name, department_id, base_salary FROM RankedSalaries WHERE rank <= 3 LIMIT 15;

title: Running Total Pembayaran
description: Tampilkan payment_date, amount, dan running_total (total kumulatif amount berdasarkan payment_date). Limit 15.
query_hints: SELECT payment_date, amount, SUM(amount) OVER (ORDER BY payment_date) as running_total FROM payments ORDER BY payment_date LIMIT 15;

title: Selisih Pesanan Sebelumnya
description: Tampilkan order_id, order_date, total_amount, dan prev_amount (total_amount dari pesanan sebelumnya berdasarkan order_date, gunakan LAG). Limit 15.
query_hints: SELECT order_id, order_date, total_amount, LAG(total_amount) OVER (ORDER BY order_date) as prev_amount FROM orders LIMIT 15;

title: Selisih Pesanan Selanjutnya
description: Tampilkan order_id, order_date, total_amount, dan next_amount (total_amount pesanan selanjutnya berdasarkan order_date, gunakan LEAD). Limit 15.
query_hints: SELECT order_id, order_date, total_amount, LEAD(total_amount) OVER (ORDER BY order_date) as next_amount FROM orders LIMIT 15;

title: Selisih dengan Rata Rata
description: Hitung rata-rata gaji per departemen di CTE. Lalu join untuk menampilkan first_name, department_id, base_salary, dan diff_from_avg (base_salary - avg_sal). Limit 10.
query_hints: WITH DeptAvg AS (SELECT department_id, AVG(base_salary) as avg_sal FROM employees e JOIN employee_salaries s ON e.employee_id = s.employee_id GROUP BY department_id) SELECT e.first_name, e.department_id, s.base_salary, ROUND((s.base_salary - d.avg_sal), 2) as diff_from_avg FROM employees e JOIN employee_salaries s ON e.employee_id = s.employee_id JOIN DeptAvg d ON e.department_id = d.department_id LIMIT 10;

title: Tanggal Pesanan Pertama
description: Tampilkan customer_id, order_id, order_date, dan first_order_date (tanggal pesanan pertama pelanggan tsb) untuk semua pesanan. Limit 15.
query_hints: SELECT customer_id, order_id, order_date, MIN(order_date) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id) as first_order_date FROM orders ORDER BY customer_id, order_date LIMIT 15;

title: Kuartil Harga Produk
description: Tampilkan product_name, price, dan quartile (nilai 1-4) mengelompokkan harga produk (NTILE). Limit 15.
query_hints: SELECT product_name, price, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY price) as quartile FROM products LIMIT 15;

title: Pelanggan Setia (>3 Pesanan)
description: Gunakan CTE untuk mencari customer dengan pesanan > 3. Tampilkan first_name, last_name, order_count. Urut abjad nama. Limit 15.
query_hints: WITH CustOrderCount AS (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(order_id) as order_count FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, o.order_count FROM customers c JOIN CustOrderCount o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_count > 3 ORDER BY c.first_name LIMIT 15;

title: Metode Pengiriman Favorit
description: Gunakan CTE dan ROW_NUMBER untuk mencari metode kirim terbanyak (method_count) di setiap city. Tampilkan city, method_name, method_count. Limit 15.
query_hints: WITH CityShipping AS (SELECT ca.city, m.method_name, COUNT(o.order_id) as method_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.city ORDER BY COUNT(o.order_id) DESC) as rn FROM orders o JOIN shipping_methods m ON o.method_id = m.method_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN customer_addresses ca ON c.customer_id = ca.customer_id GROUP BY ca.city, m.method_name) SELECT city, method_name, method_count FROM CityShipping WHERE rn = 1 LIMIT 15;
